zones.title: Find slots
zones.body: API V2 order: a missing reservation is created first from the session's dealer (CreateReservation); PATCH the selected services onto the reservation (new booking only), then GET timeslots for the reservation (or the existing booking's offer when rescheduling) in the market's window; at most maxSlotsOffered, labelled in the session language.

zones.title: Remember what was offered
zones.body: Selected services and offered slots are stored on the session so a booking or a move can only name one of them; the tool returns them by day and time, never by slotId.

panels.title: AR-12 FindSlots
panels.body: DealerBook API V2 order (endpoint sheet, 2026-10-23): the selected services are a PATCH on the reservation, then GET timeslots for the reservation in a window (fromDateTime to toDateTime, slotWindowDays of the market row). A reschedule searches the existing booking's offer id and skips the PATCH. The offered slots are written to the session row; a booking or a move can only name one of them. Labels are spoken-form weekday, date and time in the session language.
